notes.title: Update v2.98 - The first step towards Oblivity 3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Note[/h2]

Hey Oblivity Community,

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work on some major new features.

This latest update marks the first big step toward the upcoming Oblivity 3.0. As part of this massive overhaul, we’ve had to rebuild several core parts of Oblivity. With that in mind, this patch is an early rollout designed to test some of those foundational changes.

Our current plan is to release another update that will introduce one of the key features ahead of the full 3.0 release. That said, things are still in progress, so it’ll take a bit more time.

In this patch, you’ll find performance improvements and an upgraded download and search system. As always, since this is a big shift under the hood, we expect a few bumps along the way. If you run into any issues, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on Discord.

Cheers,
The Poly Games Team

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]Search System and Download system[/h3]
Some users reported issues with finding newly created Playlists or Routines. To address this, we’ve improved the search functionality in both the Trainer and Routine systems.

You can now instantly search by content ID, allowing you to directly access and download specific content without waiting for the Download Manager to fetch updates.

We’ve also made major improvements to the Download system itself — downloads are now faster, and the system prioritizes content more intelligently.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
You should notice significant performance improvements in-game, especially on lower-end devices. Fast target movements should also feel more responsive, resulting in a more fluid overall experience.

[h3]Behaviour System[/h3]
We added 2 more global variables to the behaviour system, which will allow for more complex target logic. 
- Unique round id
- Target spawn index
If you have more ideas for new action blocks or settings for the behaviour system, feel free to reach out to us. We are gonna add more features to it in the next patch.

[h3]Quality of Live and Bugs[/h3]
- added shortcuts for UI sfx, this mainly targets the hover and click sounds.
- added option to disable metronome and sens randomizer shortcuts, as it was a common confusion for new players.
- added a subtle animation for scenario hover preview
- fixed the default scenario routine issue
- behaviour system options now close when clicking away
- improved reaction time loading times for the leaderboard chart
- the scenario viewer is powered by a faster new system
- downloading a routine will now automatically activate it, if none is active
- improved the handeling of many days on the overall perforamnce chart
- fixed multiple graphical issues on the routine system search page
- fixed an issue, where on the scenario information screen the preview was not appearing
- fixed a round restart issue
- faster replay system loading times
- smarter playlist ordering algorithm

Most of the changes are under the hood, and you shouldn't notice them in the best case.

notes.title: Oblivity Update 2.9 // Sensitivity Finder Improvements, Routine UI, new Sounds
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
Hello Oblivity Community,

This update focuses on making the Sensitivity finder easier to use. We also reworked some of the Routine ingame interface, and included new sounds. Many of the new features and bug fixes in this update were inspired by your feedback on our official Discord server. We encourage you to join the conversation and help us continue to improve Oblivity! Additionally, we are now activly seeking new testers through the Discord server.

Cheers,
Poly Games


[h1]Change Logs[/h1]

[h2]Sensitivity Finder[/h2]

The goal of this update for the Sensitivity Finder is to make it easier to use and minimize user errors. We received feedback that some parts are still overwhelming for new players. Also, there were some common user errors, so we’re updating the UI to fix that. 
Because of this, we decided to completely update the First Steps and add a new quick guide on how to use the Sensitivity Finder.


Additional minor improvements to the Sensitivity Finder include:

- The optimal sensitivity is now rounded to match the number of decimal places allowed by the game.

- The optimal sensitivity will only appear after 100 rounds to stop beginners from using an inaccurate sensitivity too soon.

- A round counter ingame now shows how many rounds have been completed in the current session.

- While in the scenario, a large progress bar at the top shows how many runs are left to complete the current day.


[h3]First Steps[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/c671f37b85f821995e730b08e14617a98ef7064c.png[/img]

The First Steps have been completely updated. To make it easier for players to follow, the settings are now spread across 9 pages with additional explanations.


[h3]Sensitivity Finder Tutorials[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/ee4b3d355d168d5325ba553d637806d6909576dc.png[/img]

After finishing the First Steps, a short tutorial pop-up will appear. It contains 6 pages and gives a quick overview of the Sensitivity Finder basics for new players. You can reopen this tutorial anytime from the main screen of the Sensitivity Finder by clicking the "Help" button.



[h2]Routine Checklist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/9bd7e01c48c0c7900e5f88ef1cc4cf748d34a1c3.png[/img]

Our routine feature has also been improved to make it easier to track your progress in the game.
Now, between rounds, a small checklist will appear in the top right corner of the HUD. This shows how many rounds are left in the current scenario and what scenarios are coming up next.

Additionally, a large progress bar at the top of the screen shows how far your progress is on the current routine day.
You can now  also view your current routine directly from the ESC screen while you're in a routine.



[h2]UI Sounds[/h2]

After multiple requests for UI sounds in the menu, they are now available. This gives better feedback and should make the experience more enjoyable. More sound adjustments and additional sounds will be added in the future.


The new sounds include:

- Several hover sounds
- Multiple button click sounds
- A progression sound for the Sensitivity Finder and the routine
- A startup sound



[h2]Bugs & Quality of Live[/h2]
- Fixed arrow overlapping on the Routine Online Page
- Fixed title overlapping author on the Routine Page
- The navigation bar now closes the sens finder profile UI ingame
- Simplified the navigation bar sens profile rows
- Added setting to toggle the top progression bar

This was a Feature update, in the next patches we will focus more on bug fixing.

In the Scenario Creator, we've added several preset templates for weapons, characters, targets, and maps. These templates simplify the process of creating scenarios and make it much more user-friendly for newcomers. We can't wait to see what you create with these new features!

notes.title: Oblivity Update 2.5 // Scenario Creator, Target Behaviour System, Support Chat
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
Hello Oblivity community,
this update focuses mainly on improving the Scenario creation process, with better usability and new features.

Several of the new features and bug fixes were inspired by your suggestions on our official Discord server. We encourage you to join and contribute to enhancing Oblivity! Additionally, we're looking for new testers through the Discord server.
Cheers Poly Games

[h1]Change Logs[/h1]
[h2]Scenario Creator Rework[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/2e17fa605ee350b102e7a30f5a2185ccba999225.png[/img]
We've revamped the main Scenario Creator page, streamlining the user interface by eliminating unnecessary clutter for a more straightforward experience. Now, you can effortlessly toggle between tabs for Targets, Weapons, Characters, and Maps to adjust the essential settings for these elements directly.
 If you want to adjust more detailed features, just click on "Advanced." We've also improved how you can search for and find what you need. Plus, we've added lots of helpful tooltips that explain what different settings and sliders do, so you know exactly what the options do.

We've also made adjustments to the model editor, rearranging the spawn pool to create more room for a bigger hierarchy.

[h2]Target Behaviour System[/h2]

We've created a brand-new way for you to design how targets move and act, using something called a node editor / state machine. This tool lets you set up complex actions, like moving targets around, changing their size, spinning them, or adjusting their health when certain things happen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/305e746c2e1a0fc8cc6afc12212cd252b86677fc.png[/img]

[h3]Here's how it works[/h3]
You can find it on the Target Advanced Site, by switching from simple movement to advanced.

[b]Nodes:[/b] The Node Area is the central part where you add and move around different "Nodes." Think of nodes as the building blocks for what you want your targets to do.
 Each node represents a specific behavior or state for your targets. 
[b]Action Blocks:[/b]When you select a node, you can attach "Action Blocks" to it on the right side. These blocks are instructions that tell your targets how to act when that node is active. For example, you can make targets move differently or change in response to what's happening in the game.
Event Action Blocks: These special blocks, like a timer or a comparision, can trigger changes from one node to another. This lets you create sequences or patterns of behavior.
[b]Variables:[/b] You can use variables to keep track of information that you want to share between different nodes, like numbers or vectors.

[h3]What you can do with it[/h3]
This whole system gives you the power to control exactly how targets behave. You can make them teleport, shrink as they lose health, follow complex paths, or even mimic the player's movements. We've provided lots of actions to start with, and we'll be adding more. With a bit of creativity, you can bring a lot of exciting ideas to life!


[h2]Support Chat[/h2]
We've added a new feature in our update: now you can talk to our support team right from the game using a chat box. Plus, if you need to, you can easily move your chat over to our Discord server and keep the conversation going there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/8df3b1a435173a2b8fcf77b0cd00a0cbfbb36850.png[/img]

[h2]Bugs & Quality of Life[/h2]
- added round counter to Pause Screen
- Announcement Widget improvements
- fixed a download bar graphics issue in icon view
- fixed a issue with the sens finder widget on the start screen
- removed import buttons from target models

notes.title: Oblivity Update 2.4 // TPS, Playlist system, Settings profiles, UI overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
Hello Oblivity community,
this update focuses on a general cleanup: many bug fixes, system reworks and UI overhauls.

Several of the new features and bug fixes were inspired by your suggestions on our official Discord server. We encourage you to join and contribute to enhancing Oblivity! Additionally, we're looking for new testers through the Discord server.
Cheers Poly Games


[h1]Change Logs[/h1]
[h2]Scenario System / Trainer Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/79b840981ab5acbe193d1bc8e4e4e9d4c865065e.png[/img]
We revamped the scenario grid rows, featuring enhanced next arrows, refined scaling, and improved shading for a better visual experience. 

[h3]Playlist System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/af71ca363a3e5391b5399a8c5c529c2fbc1949a1.png[/img]
We overhauled the UI elements associated with the playlist system for a more streamlined experience. We transitioned from a playlist rating system to a straightforward like counter to address the issue of challenging playlists being unfairly downvoted. The newly generated playlist thumbnails, adjust to the scenario count and content of the playlist.

[h3]Recommendation Algorithms[/h3]
A primary focus of this update was to implement additional recommendation algorithms, aimed at showcasing a broader range of scenarios. This enhancement should simplify the discovery of high-quality scenarios and playlists, tailoring selections more closely to user preferences.
Some e.g. RecommendedPlaylists, Discover Scenarios, Players also like, You right now ...
The sensitivity finder also got some usefull additions: Recently played playlists, scenarios your played in this profile

[h3]Filter and Search[/h3]
We updated the filter system for better space efficiency and reduced clutter. Enhancements to the search algorithm now allow it to operate more smoothly in the background, minimizing lag. Additionally, a search bar has been integrated into the sensitivity finder.

[h2]TPS, Character Models, Scenario Creator improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/437e08a117c028b7555b29cb1b9e74b5c235c601.png[/img]
We've introduced a third-person system to the creator, which can be configured within the character settings. Custom character models have also been added, functioning similarly to the target models, primarily visible when utilizing a third-person character. Furthermore, the target profile page has been redesigned, featuring a new preview and an improved structure for the movement system. Additionally, when modifying the spawn angles and the minimum-maximum distance of a target, new colored indicators now appear in the scenario preview.


[h2]Settings Profile Rework[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/fc14a25283b57ab2da3c80915712fbb53c94a479.png[/img]
Unsatisfied with the previous settings profile system, we revamped the UI and system for a cleaner and more streamlined experience. Instead of toggling between profiles, you now directly apply an existing profile, setting the current profile's settings to those values. This update significantly reduces unnecessary clutter in the settings menu. We also removed the unessecary gernal, graphic, aiming and ui profiles.

[h2]Sensitivity Converter games[/h2]
We added a few more games to the sensitivty converter:
- The Finals
- Cs2
- Battlebit
- roblox
- krunker
- escape from tarkov
- destiny 2

[h2]Dashboard Widgets[/h2]
We've introduced two additional Widgets to the dashboard: the Streak Widget, enabling you to monitor your daily gameplay streak, and the Announcement Widget, which features polls for community feedback and displays key news about Oblivty.

[h2]Bugs & Quality of Life[/h2]
The most important bugs and quality of life changes, sorted by screen.

[b]Trainer[/b]
- added systems to prevent thumbnail duplicates 
- better smart play animations
- fixed scenario hover screen leaderboard graphics bug

[b]Sensitivity Finder[/b]
- added search bar
- better adjusted playlist scenario rows
- reworked sensitivity profile side bar
- fixed graphics overlap + added fade to the top
- fixed custom sensitivity calculation box bugging out

[b]Replay System[/b]
- fixed replay bug with character collision issues
- the x on the replay ui works again
- the cinematic mode now disables all UI
- you can now pause with space
- the goback button, now actually works as intended and jumps back into the last opened screen or session

[b]Ingame[/b]
- fixed visual settings not updating correctly


[b]First Steps[/b]
- fixed Continue issue after first screen
- fixed info i 
- fixed bg color issues

[b]Dashboard[/b]
- fixed graphics bugs with the overall improvement chart
- added loading graphic to overall improvement chart
- fixed graphics bugs with the scenario showcase widget

[b]Pausesscreen & Statistics[/b]
- added watch replay button
- statistics only available after  playing a round
- added scenario progression to statistics

[b]Feature screen[/b]
- improved sens converter dropdown values

[b]Scenario screen[/b]
- fixed problems with screen not getting disabled when switching scene
- navbar now expands

[b]Grid Rows[/b]
- fixed author row bugging out issue
- loop issues with older rows
- title not displaying correctly
- fixed many overlapping arrows in different screens

[b]Wrist Eye Warmup [/b]
- ui fixes
- added more audio signals


[b]Other:[/b]
- renamed csgo -> cs2
- added setting to disable replay uploads to the leaderboard

notes.title: Oblivity Update 2.1 // Wrist-Eye Warmups, Reaction Trainer, Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
Hello Oblivity community,
Introducing another exciting Oblivity feature update! You can look forward to exclusive wrist and eye exercises, a new achievement system and our new progress chart!

Many of the new features and bug fixes were requested by you on our official Discord server.
So feel free to join and help us to improve Oblivity!
We are also searching for new testers on the discord server.
Cheers Poly Games

[h1]Change Logs[/h1]

[h2]Features Screen[/h2]
Discover the new Feature screen where you can experiment with new tools and convert your sensitivity. We'll be expanding this section with more features soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/d8717fe71f0dc723f3e6a1a385fdcc4618a3eba2.png[/img]

[h3]Wrist and Eye Warmups[/h3]
In collaboration with our aim coach [b]Prince[/b], we've developed warm-ups for both your hands and eyes. These exercises aim to combat fatigue and enhance consistency in your performance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/25f0d6ac046e3d84f75ce3e5edbafa3ebe858739.png[/img]

notes.title: Oblivity Update 2.0 // Thumbnail System, Smart Play, Social Media System ....
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
Hello Oblivity community,
this is by far our biggest update yet.
We heard your feedback and complaints about our old interface, so we reworked large parts of the UI.

many of the new features and bug fixes were requested by you on our official Discord server.
So feel free to join and help us to improve Oblivity!
We are also searching for new testers on the discord server.
Cheers Poly Games

[h1]Change Logs[/h1]

[h2]Thumbnail System / UI Rework[/h2]
We've made a significant alteration by transitioning from a typical SCENARIO LIST to PREVIEW IMAGES. These thumbnail images aim to simplify scenario recognition and enhance scenario comprehension. They are created locally on your computer using the scenario file data but operate deterministically, ensuring all users generate identical thumbnails.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/2b6734bf07e09ed7fd09ff22e68944c856d33415.gif[/img]
These Thumbnails are integrated in a row-based view, with many different row designs.
We added a great variety of “Gridrows” (around 8), to display different categories or playlists. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/32c29da6968ecf79393b0ec3ba1c122196c07e06.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/69896e5a5eff01843a2cbc28fc8a0003173cc47a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/78fd9e1aaf20434935e99c34b5278b52a9538107.png[/img]

[b]Trainer new look[/b]
This is what the trainer looks like, you can scroll down to explore more Gridrows. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/3378dae7c734f3a89f7bef427f6039431624dcd0.png[/img]
These Thumbnails replace the original scenario list in every part of the UI, you will find them on the Overview, Sensitivity Finder, Ingame or while using the ultimate search bar.

[h2]Smart play[/h2]
The Smart Play algorithm automatically selects scenarios for you to play, so you don’t have to. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/c3ebaa424de701bb2e72db6fffe715cb1e993478.png[/img]

You can always click “Go Next” (F) ingame and a new Scenario will start playing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/ddd98ed862c84eb52c4a3be9007a8228ecb97a75.gif[/img]

This mode's concept is to dive right in without hunting for appropriate scenarios. It utilizes an algorithm that showcases trending scenarios and customizes to your taste. Therefore, it selects scenarios compatible with your proficiency and gaming approach. If a scenario doesn't appeal to you, simply move to the next, and the algorithm will recalibrate. This mechanism should draw more focus to new scenarios, making it easier for high-quality content to achieve popularity.


[h2]Social Media System / Author System[/h2]
With this update, Oblivity tracks your clicks, the time you spend playing, and the rounds you play in each scenario. You can see these stats and a preview by moving your cursor over a thumbnail. The data collected also helps power the 'just play' function and improves the scenario recommendation system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/d0eb3d2f5a628861e34e7d30be80659b0257e56e.png[/img]

We've also introduced a new Author Page. Here, you can view all the scenarios and playlists created by them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/1ccf37d52271c945c9cbb134705639f124efeb6d.png[/img]

You can now follow Authors to see their content in your subscription row.

[h3]Scenario Rating[/h3]
We realized that high-quality difficult scenarios had terrible ratings because they were frustrating to new players. So we moved from a rating system to a simple like system. 

[h2]New Ingame Look[/h2]
We reworked the ingame look, for better depth perception. 
It should look cleaner and more modern, to fit the UI design better.
We also adjusted the background. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/bef9c8e5549093e68efb18732c58a3d1054b6d5d.png[/img]

[h2]Pause Screen / Escape Screen[/h2]
When you click esc ingame you open the new Pause screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/8f16de10ac2e6fbb6959b59024ad843170bff0b7.png[/img]

Here, you can check your statistics, access the leaderboard, and explore recommended scenarios. Leaderboards now also have a 'friends only' feature. Recommended scenarios could be from the playlist you're currently on, or smart play scenarios. As you scroll down, you'll see a grid similar to the trainer, which allows for infinite scrolling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/70de5bea86f734b5f25bd8bf2acc852f64e7e4c5.png[/img]

[h2]Filter System[/h2]
We've implemented new Filters, allowing you to search based on scenario categories. Rest assured, the previous filters for categories such as ttk or speed are still available. We're currently developing a filter for difficulty levels.


[h2]Everything is Downloaded[/h2]
Download status indicator on the left Navbar. 

Another concept we added to Oblivity, is “Everything is downloaded”. It means Oblivity automatically downloads all new scenarios/playlists so you always have a working copy of all Content.

This removes annoying loading times altogether, and we can always display previews of scenarios. 
Also, the total size of all downloaded scenarios and playlists is only 20MB, so don’t worry (around 3000 files).

This also means that Oblivity is fully functional in offline mode.


[h2]New Playlist System / Editor[/h2]

We added a New Playlist creator.
You can now also see the status of your own playlists, and on edit, you can upload the changes.

[h2] Sensitivity Finder / Valorant Playlists[/h2]
The Sensitivity Finder UI was reworked
Added Quick Play: so you don’t have to care about selecting the right scenarios

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/434aff9938172f5958686bec9383584189e01a9c.png[/img]

We also included new Valorant Playlists for different Skill Levels


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
fixed a bug where the optimal sensitivity changes after a restart
prevent sens profile names with “/”
so many stuff should be here …

[h3]The new Profile System Explained[/h3]
We added a settings profile system, so you can create profiles for different games or users.
You can also switch just special categories e.g. only change your visual theme/ audio /crosshair ..

There are [b]FullProfiles [/b]which contain all settings and switch all settings with one click.
These FullProfiles store which SubProfiles are contained.

[b]SubProfiles [/b]contain only data of a certain categorie:
- General: Sensitivity/Fov/ADSsettings
- Audio: audiofiles and volumes
- Visuals: post processing settings / colors / bullet tracers
- Crosshair: your crosshair settings and images

The [b]Online site[/b] allows you to:

notes.title: Oblivity Update v1.6 // new Sensitivity Finder Algorithm & Screen
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Note[/h2]
Hello, Oblivity community,
many of the new features and bug fixes were requested by you on our official [url=https://discord.gg/oblivity]Discord [/url]server. 
You also helped us rework the sensitivity finder algorithm, thank you to our testers!
So feel free to join and help us to improve Oblivity!
Cheers Poly Games

[h1]Change Logs[/h1]
[h2]Sensitivity Finder[/h2]

[h3]Algorithm[/h3]
We entirely reworked the sensitivity finding algorithm. Your optimal Sensitivities will likely change on your profiles. The new algorithm is faster, more accurate, more performant, more transparent and more customizable through the advanced sens finder screen. 
This doesn't mean we finished developing on it, the algorithm will always be a work in progress, and we are dedicated to work a lot on it in the future.

- randomized start sensitivities increased from 8 to 10 (randomized order)

[h3]Advanced Sensitivity Finder Screen[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39538976/469a866d4f95e2d390ac8f3ae6673de46362c17a.png[/img]

The new [b]Advanced Sens Finder Screen[/b] allows you to view/analyze and configure your profiles.
It also makes it possible to adjust different parts of the algorithm

The [b]Chart Widget[/b] provides bigger charts that display different values over sensitivity.
- you can toggle, charts for performance, score, accuracy, and -deviation 
- The Timeline slider allows you to view the progress over time of your profile. You can watch how the performance chart develops over runs
- you can also adjust the playable sensitivity range

The [b]Scenario Widget[/b] provides a detailed breakdown of each scenario you played.
- Piechart which displays the percentage of each scenario you played
- A list with each scenario, displaying percentage, run count, optimal sensitivity for the scenario, and a smaller performance over sensitivity chart
- you can activate and deactivate scenario runs, so they have no impact on the calculation

The [b]Sensitivity Information / Progress Widget[/b] provides a lot of different settings to configure your profile.
- You can view your currently optimal sensitivity, and by hovering over it you can view more options you selected
- it allows you to adjust your playable sensitivity range. Oblivity will only test your skill on sensitivities in this range. The optimal sensitivity doesn't need to be in this range, it is only limited by the start sens range.
- enabeling "allow auto adjust range", will automaticly shrink the sensitivity range after a decent run count
- You can select and input your own performance calculation formula to find your perfect Sensitivity.
e.g If you only want to include Score and -deviation in your calculation, you can input "score - deviation". 
- You can also switch between progress profiles, or create your own one
- You can also configure a data falloff, as old data should have less impact on the final sensitivity than new runs.
 
[h3]First Steps Screen & MouseX/Y multipliers[/h3]
We added a third First Steps Page, including new algorithm settings and sensitivity X/Ý multipliers. You can access it by clicking the advanced button on the 2nd first steps page.
- configure Data falloff
- configure calculation formula: You can input your own version or use the Oblivity default one.
- configure MouseX and MouseY multipliers

[h3]Tutorial Video[/h3]
We reworked the tutorial video.
- updated graphics to fit with the current Oblivity version
- higher quality Voice-Over
- moved close button to the top right of the video

[h2]Features and Changes[/h2]

[h3]Replay System[/h3]
We added Interpolation for smoother playback. Watching replays at lower speeds will now work without lag.
Aiming Down Sight (ADS) will now be recorded to replays.

[h3]Ingame Scenario Description[/h3]
After loading into a Scenario you can view its Description, in the top left corner of the UI.
it disappears after starting a round.
Added an option to disable the description in the settings.

[h3]Searchbar [/h3]
We improved the searchbar behavior, so it works more intuitively.
- you can now close it by clicking next to the searchbar
- if you input nothing the searchbar won't display options
- the searchbar now also works in the Endscreen/Pausemenu.

[h2]Smaller features and changes [/h2]
- added caret to previous sensitivity inputfield in the first steps 
- overshoot/undershoot/deviation calculation now works better with scenarios that include movement or spawnpoints
- favorite playlists now have a better click-box
- added news popup with information to the sensitivity finder screen
- adjusted the design of the Sensitivity Information Widget

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- fixed pausing when tabbing out
- fixed a lot of problems with score calculation formulas
- fixed history sorting issues for sensitivity finder runs
- fixed a sensitivity finder bug (NAN).
- fixed issue with performance over sensitivity chart not displaying correctly
- fixed typos

[h2]Developer Note[/h2]
Hello Oblivity community,
This update focuses on improving the crosshair editor and clearing up some of the confusing UI. Most of the new features were requested by the community on our official [url=https://discord.gg/oblivity]Discord [/url]server. So feel free to join and help us to improve Oblivity!

[h1]Change Logs[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3] Crosshair [/h3]
- The [b]Crosshair Painter[/b] is a new way create crosshairs. It allows you to paint the pixels of your crosshair inside Oblivity. You can adjust the opacity of the crosshair painter overlay on the crosshair widget. The painted image gets saved as png, so you can use it in other games, too. The crosshair painter UI will be reworked in the future.

 [h3]Favorites[/h3]

[h3]Sensitivity Finder UI [/h3]

- we reworked the [b]sensitivity profile widget[/b] and adjusted how the progress gets calculated. 

[h3]Sensitivity progress system[/h3] 
To finish a profile you need
-   a certain amount of total runs
-   a certain amount of finished days (we lowered the values to finish a day)
the new [b]progress values[/b] (we will probably adjust those)
- fast: 1 day |  120 run per day | 120 total runs
- medium: 3 days |  50 run per day | 225 total runs
- accurate: 4 days | 50 runs per day | 325 total runs
- hardcore: 7 days | 75 runs per day | 630 total runs

notes.title: Oblivity Update v1.18 // Feature and performance Update
notes.content:
[h1]Developer Notes[/h1]
Hello Oblivity community, 
 Since the beginning of Oblivity, it has always been most important for us to work as closely as possible with the community and make the adjustments you have recommended. All the new features contained in this update were requested on our discord server. You can have a significant impact on improving Oblivity! We know there are still many things we need to improve, and as the developers, we are dedicated to make Oblivity the ultimate fps toolkit. Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/oblivity]discord [/url]server if you need help or if you want to improve Oblivity. 
Cheers Poly Games


[h1]Change Logs:[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[h3]First Steps[/h3]
- [ ]  We reworked the [b]First Steps[/b] as they were very confusing to new players
    - [ ]  The first steps are now structured in two different screens, with bigger fonts to increase readability.
[h3]Sensitivity Randomizer[/h3]
- [ ]  added a [b]Sensitivity Randomizer[/b] to the trainer
    - [ ]  you can adjust it options in the settings menu  under aiming.
    - [ ]  you can also select a custom hotkey to toggle it on and off  (default P)
- [ ]  added basic protection against cheat engine
[h3]Leaderboard replays[/h3]
- [ ]  the [b]leaderboards now display replays from the top 50 players[/b]
    - [ ]  if you hit a score in the top 50 the replay will be uploaded to the leaderboard
    - [ ]  added replay downloading progress bar
    -    Note: it might take some time to fill the leaderboards with replays, as you need to hit new  highscores in order to upload your performance.
    
- [ ]  added setting to switch monitor
- [ ]  added titles to the settings menu to increase readability

[h2]Performance[/h2]
- [ ]  big performance update.
- better performance after finishing round
- improved performance with multiple sensitivity profiles
- improved playlist/scenario table performance significantly
- [ ]  Ingame performance
    - [ ]  optimized runtime code
    - [ ]  adjusted rendering settings for better performance
- [ ]  Oblivity now doesn't run in the background
    - [ ]  as some people encountered tabbing issues, this seems to be the easiest fix

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- [ ]  fixed playlist downloading
- [ ]  fixed new issues of v1.11
- [ ]  fixed time scale adjustments
- [ ]  fixed a sensitivity issue of v1.13
- [ ]  fixed some issues with the new first steps
- [ ]  fixed some weird highscore bugs
- [ ]  the score widget now updates the 4.6% since last session
- [ ]  fixed blur Problem
- [ ]  smaller changes
- [ ]  fixed some small bugs and issues
- [ ]  fixed the replay wrong sound issues

[h2]Small Adjustments[/h2]
- [ ]  Playlists are now correctly displayed using the ultimate searchbar
- [ ]  improved the file browser
- [ ]  Playlists won't refresh scenarios after download, leading to weird behaviors
- [ ]  FOV now updates in the replay system
- [ ]  changes to prepare updates to the model editor
- [ ]  bigger scenario preview
